reason: The September net return row on Treasury is a plain div with a click handler: no role, no tabindex, no focusable child. Tab walks 62 stops and passes from the allocation card to the Oct 2 transfer row without stopping on it (shot:a11y/runs/2026-10-03-1525/shots/verify/verify-053/accounts.treasury-net-return-row-skipped-by-tab.png). That row is the only control I found that opens the September 2026 net return dialog, which shows the MCRYX and MRGXX dividends and the Treasury fee behind the figure, so a keyboard user cannot reach the breakdown and no equivalent keyboard path exists.

The dl holds div wrappers that each contain a dt and a plain div standing in for the dd (the markup carries an as="dd" attribute on a div), so the list exposes terms with no definitions (ax probe: DescriptionList with no name). The label and amount of each line still read in order, so the pairing survives in reading order and the impact is small, but 1.3.1 is not met.
